import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    null_values = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null"]

    return raw.select(
        account=pl.col("@Account").str.strip_chars(),
        txn_date=pl.col("Date")
        .str.to_date(format="%d/%m/%Y", strict=False)
        .cast(pl.Date),
        description=pl.col("Details"),
        amount=pl.col("Amount")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        balance=pl.col("Balance")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        reference=pl.col("Reference"),
    ).with_columns(
        [
            pl.col(col).fill_null(None)
            for col in raw.columns
            if col in [
                "@Account",
                "Date",
                "Details",
                "Amount",
                "Balance",
                "Reference",
            ]
        ]
    ).select(
        "account",
        "txn_date",
        "description",
        "amount",
        "balance",
        "reference",
    )
